prompt: Need a checkout_total(items, coupon=None) in shop/pricing.py. items is a list of (unit_price_cents, qty) pairs; coupon is an optional code looked up case-insensitively in a new COUPONS table (start it with SAVE10 = 10% and HALF = 50%). Apply the coupon to the subtotal with the existing discount rule, then add tax the usual way, and return int cents. Unknown codes should raise ValueError.
